lead_raw_text:
The structure of Y2InAg crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms—8 Y, 4 In, and 4 Ag—distributed across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers with 9 neighbors (5 Y, 4 In), while In centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 neighbors (6 In, 6 Y). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between In 12-vertex polyhedra and both Ag and Y polyhedra, with In–Y pairs showing corner and face sharing.
